hints.title: Smallest Letter Frequency
hints.text: For any string, identify its alphabetically earliest letter and count how many times it appears in the string.

hints.title: Sort Word Frequency Array
hints.text: Precalculate the frequency function value for each string in words and sort these values in ascending order.

hints.title: Divide and Count strictly greater
hints.text: For each query, calculate its frequency value and locate its upper boundary in the sorted word frequency array to determine how many words have strictly greater frequencies.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.time: O((W + Q) * L + Q log W)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every query against every word takes quadratic O(Q * W * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the word frequencies enables logarithmic lookup per query.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement string frequency evaluation and logarithmic boundary search.
complexity.notes: Strings contain only lowercase English letters.
